ideas.pitch: A companion web and sensor dashboard that mounts onto the RC car to stream wheel speed, motor temperature, and battery draw via ESP32 to help optimize assembly alignment and racing lines.
ideas.title: PitStopTelemetry: Real-Time RC Car Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since winners are judged on the combined total time of assembly and racing, giving teams a way to quickly diagnose mechanical friction or motor heating directly attacks the scoring metric.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser tool where builders can input custom dimensions of their RC chassis to 3D model or paper-craft snap-on aerodynamic downforce wings optimized for the event track layout.
ideas.title: AeroTuner: Computational Body Shell Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leans into the manufacturing and creativity pillar of the SME-organized event by providing a tangible engineering edge during the assembly phase.

ideas.pitch: A standalone webcam-based lap timer utilizing OpenCV and ArUco markers placed on the RC cars to automatically track heat times down to the millisecond without relying on manual stopwatches.
ideas.title: ChronosLap: Computer Vision Gate Timing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automates the racing phase tracking with high precision, removing human error in timekeeping and providing instant feedback for drivers tuning their cars between rounds.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, step-by-step augmented assembly guide featuring interactive 3D exploded views of the RC components to speed up the kit-building phase and prevent common alignment mistakes.
ideas.title: GearSim: Assembly Guide & Torque Checklist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the assembly phase time reduction gives teams a direct advantage in the combined total time score, as assembly speed is weighted equally with racing performance.

ideas.pitch: A hardware modification kit integrating an Arduino-based steering wheel peripheral with custom tactile feedback to improve driver precision through tight track corners during the semi-finals and finals.
ideas.title: SteerHaptic: Custom Controller Mod for RC Handling
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines unusual physical hardware building with a live, demonstrable edge on track handling, mirroring past hardware-focused hackathon winners.
